A selection lens

Five questions before the vendor list.

The right layer depends less on feature count than on where meaning should be governed and how many consumers must share it.

Read the methodology ↗
  1. 01
    Where is the source of truth?

    Warehouse, transformation project, standalone service, or BI platform?

  2. 02
    Who must consume it?

    One BI tool, many tools, embedded apps, spreadsheets, or autonomous agents?

  3. 03
    How deep is the model?

    Simple KPIs, or hierarchies, semi-additivity, role-playing dimensions, and many-to-many?

  4. 04
    Where does policy execute?

    At the warehouse, semantic runtime, application, or all three?

  5. 05
    What must remain portable?

    Definitions, query semantics, security, AI context, or the entire runtime?
